project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend with pure calculation engines
build_system: npm + Vite, orchestrated via top-level Makefile
test_framework: vitest with describe/it/expect pattern, tests in __tests__/ directory
verification_instructions: 1. Run `make typecheck` to confirm no TS errors. 2. Run `make test` to confirm all tests pass. 3. Run `make build` to confirm production build succeeds.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - npm packages can be installed from public registries.
contribution_requirements: Engines are pure TypeScript modules with no side effects, no DB calls, no external dependencies. Each engine exports from index.ts. Tests use vitest with golden test fixtures pattern.
key_patterns: 1. Engine files export a single main function. 2. Input/output types defined in types.ts. 3. EngineError class for validation errors. 4. Tests use describe blocks with golden test fixtures naming convention. 5. Index.ts re-exports all engine functions and types.
directory_structure: frontend/src/engines/ - pure calculation engines. frontend/src/engines/__tests__/ - vitest test files. Each engine has a corresponding test file.
